name: Hormozi Grand Slam value stack

sources.name: Alex Hormozi $100M Offers — value equation + Grand Slam Offer stack
sources.note: Dream outcome, likelihood, time delay, effort/sacrifice; stack components until saying no feels irrational.

density.length_band: match stack density; do not pad

components.hint: What's included / everything you get when you {dream outcome}
One line: dream outcome + lower effort/time
Each item is one stacked offer component, not a vague benefit
Restate stack in one sentence + warranty + financing lines

reasons.heading_hint: The core product that delivers the dream outcome
Built-in mechanism that raises odds of success (e.g. red light standard)
Faster path (plug-and-play, app preheat, no electrician)
Included extras normally sold separate — only if verified
Warranty / shipping / support as stack finishers — verified only

notes: No invented dollar values on bonuses.
Every numeric stack claim needs a claim_id.

reason_fills: Medical-grade red light included standard (not an upsell) — verified claim only
Standard outlet / no electrician when true for the model
Free shipping + warranty lines as closing stack items
